newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STERLING FIRMS ON BCE IN LOWEST TURNOVER IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: STERLING FIRMS ON BCE IN LOWEST TURNOVER IN 1997.

text.p: Sterling futures bucked generally falling prices on Monday on the Budapest Commodity Exchange which posted this year's lowest turnover of 245 million forints.
Sterling prices firmed by 2.42 forints to 316.92 forints for September and by 2.04 forints to 325.49 forints for December.
Dollar and mark prices dipped slightly on what one market participant explained by little changes in the dollar/mark cross.
Most US dollar deals were made for September with settlement price dipping 19 fillers to 191.41 forints.
All mark deals were done for December with the settlement price easing 15 fillers to 115.90.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange's currency futures section two deals worth a total 526.9 million forints were made for December 1998, with the settlement price rising 1.70 forints to 131.70.
